sn22.118:1.3: rūpaṃ “etaṃ mama esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassathāti?
sn22.118:1.6: rūpaṃ bhikkhave “netaṃ mama nesohamasmi, na me so attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.118:1.10: viññāṇaṃ “etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attā”ti samanupassathāti?
sn22.118:1.13: viññāṇaṃ bhikkhave, “netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.118:1.14: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati …pe… vedanāyapi …pe… saññāyapi …pe… saṅkhāresupi …pe… viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati, nibbindaṃ virajjati …pe…
